## 🎵 TikTok Video Downloader (No Watermark)

Looking for a **TikTok video downloader** for Node.js? This package downloads TikTok videos **without watermark** in HD quality, plus MP3 audio extraction — no login, no cookies, no API keys required. One of the fastest `tiktok-downloader` npm packages with automatic fallback across multiple sources.

```js
const { alldl } = require('rahad-all-downloader-v2');
const video = await alldl('https://www.tiktok.com/@user/video/123456');
console.log(video.url); // HD, no watermark
```

## 🛡️ Never-Down Fallback System (v2.9.0)

Every platform has an **ordered chain of independent sources**. If one API goes down, the next takes over automatically — you never see the failure.

```js
const alldl = require('rahad-all-downloader-v2');

// Works even if the primary TikTok API is down —
// the chain tries tikwm → ssstik → tiktokio → nntech → downbloder → direct scrape
const video = await alldl('https://www.tiktok.com/@user/video/123');
```

**Self-healing sources:** a source that fails 3 times in a row is skipped for 10 minutes (cooldown), then automatically retried. Flaky APIs stop slowing you down.

```js
// Inspect source health
console.log(alldl.sourceHealth());
// { "tiktok:tikwm": { fails: 0, inCooldown: false }, "youtube:piped1": { fails: 3, inCooldown: true, cooldownEndsInMs: 420000 } }

// Probe every source (for debugging — never throws)
const status = await alldl.checkSources();
// { tiktok: { "tiktok:tikwm": "up", "tiktok:ssstik": "up", ... }, youtube: { ... } }
```

**Sources per platform (v2.12.0):** TikTok 6 · YouTube 5 · Twitter/X 3 · Snapchat 2 · TeraBox 2 · Kwai 2 · CapCut 3 · Moj 2 · Likee 2 · Reddit 3 · Pinterest 2 · Josh 2 · Facebook 2 · Instagram 2 · Rumble 2 · Twitch 2 · Vimeo 2 · Dailymotion 2 · Threads 2 · GDrive 1 · MEGA 1 · MediaFire 1 · Bilibili 1 · SoundCloud 1 · Spotify 1 · Douyin 1 · Xiaohongshu 1 · Deezer 1 · Apple Music 1 · Bandcamp 1 · Pixeldrain 1 · Gofile 1 · Odysee 1 · PeerTube 1 · Kick 1 · VK 1 · Weibo 1 · Mixcloud 1 · Audiomack 1 — all free, no keys, no login.

**rahad-all-downloader-v2** is an all-in-one media downloader for Node.js. If you searched for any of these, you're in the right place:

### TikTok Video Downloader
Download TikTok videos without watermark in HD, plus TikTok MP3 audio extraction — no login required.

### Instagram Video Downloader
Download Instagram Reels, posts and IGTV videos in high quality without logging in.

### Facebook Video Downloader
Download Facebook videos in HD & SD quality with a single function call.

### YouTube Video Downloader
Download YouTube videos and Shorts with automatic fallback for maximum reliability.

### Twitter / X Video Downloader
Download X (Twitter) videos and photos in multiple qualities.

### Snapchat, Pinterest, Threads, Likee, CapCut & Kwai Downloader
Also supports Snapchat Spotlight & Stories, Pinterest, Threads, Likee, CapCut, Kwai, Reddit, Moj, Josh, Rumble, Twitch, Streamable, Tumblr, Bluesky, Loom, Rutube, OK.ru, BitChute and more — 54 platforms in one lightweight package.

## 🚀 Quick Start

One function handles everything — it auto-detects the platform from the URL:

```js
const { alldl } = require('rahad-all-downloader-v2');

(async () => {
  const result = await alldl('https://www.tiktok.com/@user/video/1234567890');

  console.log(result.data.title);    // "Funny cat video 🐱"
  console.log(result.data.videoUrl); // "https://.../download.mp4" — direct link!
  console.log(result.data.source);   // "TikTok"
})();
```

## ℹ️ Video Info (no download)

Get only metadata without downloading — title, author, thumbnail, duration:

```js
const { alldl } = require('rahad-all-downloader-v2');

const meta = await alldl.info('https://www.tiktok.com/@khaby.lame/video/7081291571970329861');
console.log(meta);
// {
//   site: 'tiktok',
//   platform: 'tiktok',          // alias of site — consistent shape on every site
//   url: 'https://www.tiktok.com/@khaby.lame/video/7081291571970329861',
//   title: 'He doesn’t want to be my friend 😢🥺 ...',
//   author: { name: 'Khabane lame', url: 'https://www.tiktok.com/@khaby.lame' },
//   uploader: 'Khabane lame',    // flat alias of author.name
//   thumbnail: 'https://p16-common-sign.tiktokcdn-us.com/...',  // ⚠️ signed URL — expires!
//   duration: 34,       // seconds, null if unavailable
//   description: '...'
// }

// For Facebook / Instagram, an app token is required (your own — never hardcode):
const fbMeta = await alldl.info('https://www.facebook.com/watch/?v=123', { appToken: 'APP_ID|APP_SECRET' });
```

**Field availability per site** (✅ = available, ➖ = null). Every result also
carries `platform` (alias of `site`) and `uploader` (alias of `author.name`):

| Site | title | author | thumbnail | duration | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| YouTube | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ (maxres) | ✅ | ➖ |
| TikTok | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ (⚠️ expires) | ✅ | ✅ (= title) |
| Vimeo | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |
| Facebook* | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ➖ | ➖ |
| Instagram* | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ➖ | ➖ |
| Pinterest | ✅ | ➖ | ✅ | ➖ | ✅ |
| Dailymotion | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ (views) |
| Reddit | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ➖ | ✅ |
| Moj | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |
| Josh | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |
| Rumble | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ➖ | ➖ |
| Twitch | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ➖ |
| Others / unknown | ✅ (og:) | ➖ | ✅ (og:) | ➖ | ✅ (og:) |

\* `appToken` required — returns an honest error without it.

## ⬇️ Download to Disk

Save directly to disk as a file, with progress callback:

```js
const { alldl } = require('rahad-all-downloader-v2');

const file = await alldl.download(
  'https://www.tiktok.com/@user/video/1234567890',
  './videos/', // folder → auto filename from title; file path → used as-is
  {
    onProgress: ({ percent, done, total }) =>
      console.log(`Downloading... ${percent ?? '?'}%`),
  }
);

console.log(file.path);  // "./videos/Funny cat video.mp4"
console.log(file.bytes); // file size in bytes
```

### 🎚️ Quality Selector

```js
// named: best (default) | high | medium | low | worst | audio
const r = await alldl('TIKTOK_URL', { quality: 'high' });
const file = await alldl.download('FB_URL', './videos/', { quality: 'medium' });

// explicit heights — closest stream at or under the target (never upscale);
// when nothing fits under it, the smallest stream above it
const hd = await alldl('X_URL', { quality: '720p' });
const fhd = await alldl.download('REDDIT_URL', './videos/', { quality: '1080p' });
const bare = await alldl('VIMEO_URL', { quality: 720 }); // bare number works too

// height cap — highest stream with height <= maxHeight
const capped = await alldl('REDDIT_URL', { maxHeight: 480 });
```

The same values work on the CLI: `rahad-dl "<url>" -q 720p`

YouTube now exposes every rendition it finds (`download.videos`: 2160p/1440p/1080p/720p/480p/360p …),
so a height pick chooses a real stream. Resolutions above 720p on YouTube are usually
video-only adaptive streams (YouTube serves 1080p+ without audio unless muxed) — picking one
downloads that video stream, and the result says so with `pickedVideoOnly: true`. Every pick
records what was actually chosen in `data.pickedQuality` (resolve) and on the download result:

```js
const r = await alldl('YOUTUBE_URL', { quality: '2160p' });
console.log(r.data.pickedQuality); // "1080p" — nearest lower stream when 4K is not offered
console.log(r.data.pickedVideoOnly); // true when the picked stream has no audio track
```

LinkedIn exposes its post renditions the same way.

### 🎵 Audio Only (MP3)

```js
const song = await alldl.download('TIKTOK_URL', './music/', { audioOnly: true });
// → "./music/Video title.mp3" (TikTok music, Kwai audio, YouTube audio)
```

`{ audioOnly: true }` also works on the bare resolve — `alldl('YOUTUBE_URL', { audioOnly: true })`
returns the audio stream URL as `data.videoUrl`. If a platform has no audio stream, the call
falls back to the video instead of throwing, and says so in `data.note` (same `note` on the
`download()` result).

### 🎧 Audio Bitrate & Format

```js
// closest audio stream at or near 192 kbps, saved as .m4a
const song = await alldl.download('YOUTUBE_URL', './music/', {
  audioOnly: true,
  audioBitrate: 192,
  audioFormat: 'm4a',
});
console.log(song.pickedAudio);
// { format: 'm4a', bitrate: 128, savedAs: '.m4a', requestedFormat: 'm4a',
//   requestedBitrate: 192, formatFallback: false }
```

`audioBitrate` accepts 128, 192 or 320 (any number works — the closest stream the source
offers is picked). `audioFormat` accepts `'mp3' | 'm4a' | 'opus' | 'wav'`. No re-encoding
happens: the format is picked from the audio streams the source actually serves. `'mp3'`
saves the best audio stream as `.mp3` with ID3 tags (title + uploader/artist + cover art);
`'m4a'` picks the AAC/MP4 audio stream; `'opus'` picks the Opus/WebM audio stream. No
source serves WAV, so `'wav'` always falls back to the closest available stream and says so
in the result (`pickedAudio.formatFallback: true` and a `note` on the download result).
The same options work on the CLI: `rahad-dl "<url>" --mp3 --bitrate 192 --audio-format m4a`.

### 🖼️ Thumbnail Save

```js
const file = await alldl.download('YOUTUBE_URL', './videos/', { thumbnail: true });
console.log(file.path); // "./videos/Video title.mp4"
console.log(file.thumbnailPath); // "./videos/Video title_thumb.jpg"
```

`{ thumbnail: true }` downloads the video's cover image next to the video file
(`<title>_thumb.jpg`, `.png`/`.webp` when the source serves that type) in the same call,
before the thumbnail URL has a chance to expire. When a video has no thumbnail URL the
download still succeeds and the result notes it (`thumbnailNote`). CLI: `rahad-dl "<url>" --thumb`.

## 🌊 Stream — Pipe Media Without Saving a File

`alldl.stream(url, opts)` resolves the link exactly like `download()` (same `quality` and
`audioOnly` picks) and returns a Node.js `Readable` stream of the media bytes — no file is
written to disk. Pipe it straight to an HTTP response, to ffmpeg, or anywhere else:

```js
const { alldl } = require('rahad-all-downloader-v2');
const express = require('express');
const app = express();

app.get('/video', async (req, res) => {
  const stream = await alldl.stream(req.query.url, { quality: '720p' });
  res.setHeader('Content-Type', 'video/mp4');
  res.setHeader('Content-Disposition', `attachment; filename="${stream.title}.mp4"`);
  stream.pipe(res);
});

app.listen(3000);
```

The stream carries the resolved metadata as properties: `stream.title`, `stream.source`,
`stream.videoUrl`, and `stream.pickedQuality` / `stream.pickedAudio` when a pick was made.
`opts.onProgress` works the same way as on `download()`. If the link cannot be resolved,
the returned promise rejects — it never yields an empty stream. HLS-manifest sources
(Dailymotion, Vimeo, NicoNico, Kick clips) cannot be piped as a single stream, so `stream()`
rejects those with a clear error — use `download()` for them. CLI:
`rahad-dl "<url>" --stdout | ffmpeg -i - out.mp4`.

## 🧠 Buffer — Whole File in Memory (Serverless)

`alldl.buffer(url, opts)` is `stream()` collected into a single `Buffer` — built for
serverless functions (Vercel, Cloudflare Workers) and other places where disk is limited
or ephemeral:

```js
const { alldl } = require('rahad-all-downloader-v2');

const buf = await alldl.buffer('https://www.tiktok.com/@user/video/1234567890');
console.log(buf.length); // bytes in memory
```

Warning: the whole file lives in memory, so a very large video can exhaust it. For big
files use `stream()` instead — it flows bytes through without holding them all at once.

## 🔍 Detect & Validate — Before You Download

```js
alldl.isSupported('https://www.tiktok.com/@user/video/123'); // true
alldl.isSupported('https://example.com/video.mp4');           // false
alldl.detectPlatform('https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dQw4w9WgXcQ'); // "youtube"
alldl.detectPlatform('https://example.com/video.mp4');                // null
```

`isSupported(url)` returns `true` only when the URL matches a real supported platform;
`detectPlatform(url)` returns the platform key (`"tiktok"`, `"youtube"`, `"instagram"`,
`"facebook"`, …) or `null` for anything unknown. Use them to validate user input before
calling `alldl()`, `download()`, `stream()` or `buffer()`.

```bash
npx rahad-dl --batch-file ./urls.txt -o ./batch  # one URL per line in a file
```

## 🚀 Serve Mode — Your Own Downloader API

One command. Self-hosted API + web UI. No Cobalt deploy, no Python.

```bash
npx rahad-all-downloader-v2 serve --port 3000
# with API key + proxy:
npx rahad-all-downloader-v2 serve --port 3000 --api-key SECRET --proxy http://user:pass@host:port
```

Then open http://localhost:3000 — beautiful web UI, paste any link and download.

**REST API:**
| Method | Endpoint | Body |
|--------|----------|------|
| POST | `/api/download` | `{ url, quality, audioOnly }` → `{ title, source, videoUrl }` |
| POST | `/api/info` | `{ url }` → metadata |
| GET | `/api/file?url=` | streams the file with nice filename |
| GET | `/api/health` | `{ status: "ok" }` |

API key (optional): send `x-api-key` header or `?key=` param.

```js
// programmatic:
const server = await alldl.serve({ port: 3000, apiKey: 'SECRET' });

// proxy for geo-blocked content:
alldl.setProxy('http://user:pass@host:port');

// rotate proxies round-robin (auto-switch on each request):
alldl.setProxy(['http://p1:8080', 'http://p2:8080']);
console.log(alldl.getProxy()); // ['http://p1:8080', 'http://p2:8080']
alldl.setProxy(null); // disable

// per-request proxy (overrides global, concurrency-safe):
await alldl.download('VIDEO_URL', './', { proxy: 'http://p3:8080' });

// `{ proxies: [...] }` works everywhere `{ proxy }` does — resolve, download,
// batch, playlistDownload, per-platform calls, search, info:
await alldl('VIDEO_URL', { proxies: ['http://p1:8080', 'http://p2:8080'] });

// smart rotation: a proxy that fails 3 times is skipped for a 5-minute cooldown
// while healthy proxies keep serving; retries land on the next proxy automatically.
console.log(alldl.getProxyStats());
// { mode: 'rotate', list: [...], current: [...],
//   proxies: { 'http://p1:8080': { fails: 0, inCooldown: false, cooldownEndsIn: 0 } } }
```

## 🐳 Docker — 1-Click Deploy

```bash
docker run -p 3000:3000 mrrahad404/rahad-all-downloader-v2
# with API key:
docker run -p 3000:3000 -e RAHAD_API_KEY=secret mrrahad404/rahad-all-downloader-v2
# with proxy:
docker run -p 3000:3000 -e RAHAD_PROXY=http://user:pass@host:port mrrahad404/rahad-all-downloader-v2
```

Or build yourself:
```bash
docker build -t rahad-all-downloader-v2 .
docker run -p 3000:3000 rahad-all-downloader-v2
```

Works on any VPS, Railway, Render, or home server.

## 📋 Playlist Download

```js
const pl = await alldl.playlist('YOUTUBE_PLAYLIST_URL');
console.log(pl.title, pl.count); // 25 videos

// TikTok user profiles work too:
const tk = await alldl.playlist('https://www.tiktok.com/@username', { limit: 30 });

// Instagram carousel/album posts → every media item (videos + photos):
const ig = await alldl.playlist('https://www.instagram.com/p/SHORTCODE/', { limit: 10 });
for (const item of ig.videos) {
  // item.mediaUrl is a direct CDN URL — download it without re-resolving:
  await alldl._downloadDirect(item.mediaUrl, './carousel/', {}, { title: item.title, source: 'Instagram' });
}

for (const v of pl.videos) {
  await alldl.download(v.url, './playlist/');
}
```

Playlist entries carry `{ videoId, title, url }`; Instagram carousel entries
add `mediaUrl` (a direct CDN URL) so they can be fetched without resolving.

YouTube channels expand the same way — `@handle`, `/channel/UC…`, `/c/name`, `/user/name`
(first page of the Videos tab, up to `limit`, default 50):

```js
const ch = await alldl.playlist('https://www.youtube.com/@SomeChannel/videos', { limit: 20 });
console.log(ch.title, ch.count); // 20 videos
```

Download a whole playlist/channel/profile in one call (files land in `./downloads` by
default, override with `opts.dest`; `quality`, `audioOnly`, `subtitles`, `concurrency`
and `onItem` pass through to every video; one failure never stops the rest):

```js
const done = await alldl.playlistDownload('YOUTUBE_PLAYLIST_URL', { dest: './playlist/', limit: 10 });
console.log(done.title, done.count);
for (const item of done.results) {
  console.log(item.ok ? `✅ ${item.path}` : `❌ ${item.url} — ${item.error}`);
}
```

## 🔴 Live Stream Recording

Record a YouTube Live or Twitch live stream while it is broadcasting — the HLS segments
are downloaded as they appear and joined into a single file:

```js
const rec = await alldl.recordLive('https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=LIVE_ID', {
  duration: 120, // seconds (default 60, max 3600)
  dest: './recordings/',
  onProgress: (p) => console.log(`${p.elapsed}s — ${p.segments} segments, ${p.bytes} bytes`),
});
console.log(rec.path); // "./recordings/Stream title (live).ts"
console.log(rec.segments, rec.secondsRecorded, rec.endedEarly);
```

If the stream is not live right now the call fails with an honest error
(`"Stream is not live — …"`) instead of recording nothing. Recording stops cleanly at
`duration` or when the stream ends, whichever comes first (`endedEarly: true` when the
stream ended first). A segment that fails downloads is retried once, then skipped — one bad
segment never kills the recording. CLI:

```bash
rahad-dl "<live_url>" --live --duration 120 -o ./recordings
```

## 📝 Subtitles (.srt)

```js
const sub = await alldl.subtitles('YOUTUBE_URL', { lang: 'bn', dest: './subs/' });
console.log(sub.path); // "./subs/Video title.bn.srt"

// List available subtitle tracks without downloading:
const info = await alldl('YOUTUBE_URL', { subtitles: true });
console.log(info.data.subtitles);
// [{ lang: 'en', name: 'English', url: '...' }, ...]

// Convert any caption track (VTT / TTML / srv3 XML) to .srt text yourself:
const srt = alldl.subtitlesToSrt(vttText);
```

`{ subtitles: true }` is supported for YouTube and TikTok (where the video
exposes captions); every other platform returns `[]` — it never throws.
LinkedIn caption tracks are also listed when the post exposes them.
CLI: `rahad-dl "<url>" --subs bn` downloads the video plus the `.srt` side by side.

Pass `{ subtitles: 'en' }` (or `true` for English) to `download()` and the `.srt` is saved
next to the video file — the result carries its path as `subtitlePath`:

```js
const file = await alldl.download('YOUTUBE_URL', './videos/', { subtitles: 'bn' });
console.log(file.path); // "./videos/Video title.mp4"
console.log(file.subtitlePath); // "./videos/Video title.bn.srt" (when captions exist)
```

## 📚 Batch Download

Many URLs at once — if one fails, the rest keep going:

```js
const results = await alldl.batch(
  ['TIKTOK_URL', 'IG_URL', 'YT_URL'],
  {
    concurrency: 3, // max concurrent requests (1–10)
    onProgress: (done, total, item) => console.log(done + '/' + total, item.ok ? 'done' : item.error),
  }
);
// results[i] = { url, ok: true, result } or { url, ok: false, error } — order matches the input

// Or feed URLs from a file (one per line; # comments and blanks skipped):
//   rahad-dl --batch-file ./urls.txt -o ./videos
// → resolves + downloads each with concurrency 3, prints per-URL ✅/❌ lines
//   and a final "X succeeded, Y failed" summary.
```

## 🔎 Search, Cache & Cookies

```js
// Keyword search (YouTube or TikTok), then resolve the top hit in one call:
const hits = await alldl.search('lofi music', { platform: 'youtube', limit: 5 });
// hits = [{ id, title, url, duration, views, author, thumbnail }]
const dl = await alldl.searchDownload('lofi music', { platform: 'youtube' });
// dl = { query, picked, result }

// Repeat lookups are cached in memory for 5 minutes (RAHAD_CACHE_TTL_MS to tune, 0 = off):
const again = await alldl('SAME_URL');                 // served from cache
const fresh = await alldl('SAME_URL', { cache: false }); // force a fresh lookup
alldl.cacheStats(); // { size, ttlMs, maxEntries }
alldl.clearCache();

// Private or age-gated Facebook/Instagram content? Attach your own session cookie:
alldl.setCookie('instagram', 'sessionid=...; ds_user_id=...');
const priv = await alldl.insta('PRIVATE_REEL_URL'); // or pass { cookie } per call
alldl.clearCookies(); // all platforms, or clearCookies('instagram')
```

---

## 🔁 Auto-Retry & Quality Preference

```js
// Retries transient failures twice (with backoff)
const r = await alldl('TIKTOK_URL', { retries: 2 });

// X/Twitter: for 720p, selects the closest quality at or below it
const x = await alldl.x('X_URL', { quality: '720p' });

// Slow network? Raise the API timeout (default 20000ms)
alldl.setTimeout(45000);
console.log(alldl.getTimeout()); // 45000
```

## 🎯 Platform-Specific Methods

Need rich metadata — likes, comments, thumbnails, duration? Call the platform directly:

```js
const { alldl } = require('rahad-all-downloader-v2');

(async () => {
  const tiktok    = await alldl.tiktok('TIKTOK_URL');
  const facebook  = await alldl.fb('FACEBOOK_URL');
  const instagram = await alldl.insta('INSTAGRAM_URL');
  const threads   = await alldl.threads('THREADS_URL');
  const youtube   = await alldl.youtube('YOUTUBE_URL');
  const x         = await alldl.x('X_URL');
  const snapchat  = await alldl.snapchat('SNAPCHAT_URL');
  const pinterest = await alldl.pinterest('PINTEREST_URL');
  const likee     = await alldl.likee('LIKEE_URL');
  const capcut    = await alldl.capcut('CAPCUT_URL');
  const kwai      = await alldl.kwai('KWAI_URL');
  const reddit    = await alldl.reddit('REDDIT_URL');
  const moj       = await alldl.moj('MOJ_URL');
  const josh      = await alldl.josh('JOSH_URL');

  console.log(tiktok);
})();
```

## 📘 TypeScript & ESM

Full type definitions ship with the package. Native ESM works out of the box:

```ts
import { alldl } from 'rahad-all-downloader-v2';

const res = await alldl('https://vt.tiktok.com/XXXX/');
const url: string = res.data.videoUrl; // fully typed ✅
```

## ⚙️ Error Handling

```js
const { alldl } = require('rahad-all-downloader-v2');

try {
  const result = await alldl('https://www.tiktok.com/@user/video/1234567890');
  // use result.data.videoUrl
} catch (error) {
  console.error('Download failed:', error.message);
}
```

## ❓ FAQ

<details>
<summary><b>Do I need an API key or login?</b></summary>
<br>
No. The package works out of the box — no API keys, no cookies, no login required.
</details>

<details>
<summary><b>Does it remove the TikTok watermark?</b></summary>
<br>
Yes. TikTok videos are extracted in HD without any watermark.
</details>

<details>
<summary><b>Which Node.js versions are supported?</b></summary>
<br>
Node.js 16 and above.
</details>

<details>
<summary><b>Can I use it with TypeScript / ESM?</b></summary>
<br>
Yes. Type definitions (<code>index.d.ts</code>) and native ESM (<code>index.mjs</code>) are included.
</details>
